neuroscientist

03What are you uncertain about right now? Could it be exciting instead of scary?

Speaking · Science in action

Your life is a lab

01Have you ever designed an experiment on yourself — a new routine, a diet, a study method?
02What theory have you formed about people that you'd love to prove?
03If you could carry out research on any topic in the world, what would it be?
04What do you track — steps, sleep, money, mood? Does it change anything?
05How do you reward yourself for hard work?
06What habit would you love to get rid of?
07Do you submit things before the deadline — or at 23:59?
08If you could place anything under a microscope, what would it be?
09If you carried out a survey among your friends about happiness, what would you ask?
Listening · 5A

Life hacks

When your to-do list has its own to-do list
Life hack/laɪf hæk/ · noun [countable]

A simple solution or a piece of advice that helps you solve a problem, save time or improve how something works.

01What's the best life hack you know for your phone, your home, food or travel?
02Have you ever tried a hack from Instagram or TikTok that totally failed?
03What are your best hacks for surviving a big city — traffic, the metro, stress, no time?
04Is the internet "the ultimate life hack"? What else would you put near the top of the list of inventions?

Curiosity killed

Critical thinking · 5B · Game

Don't believe it — ask!

Ask at least 2 critical questions about each headline. Then decide: do you believe it?

Who carried out the research?Who paid for it?How was ___ measured?How many people were tested?For how long?Could something else explain it?Has it been repeated?
So… do you really need to travel to be happy?
